name: My Horny Roomies
source: Four girls. One free room. A shared house full of sexual tension. During the day, you choose who to spend your time with. At night… things heat up. They all want to fuck you. Which one will you choose?
translation: 四个女孩，一间空房，一栋弥漫着暧昧性张力的合租屋。白天，你自由选择要与谁共度时光；到了夜晚……气氛骤然升温。她们全都想和你上床。你会选择哪一个？
